datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2015 in Zambia. The classifications were spatially mapped to geographic units and stored in GeoJSON and KML formats, representing current food insecurity situations across different scenarios and time periods.
